dimension_description: This scale stores acoustic intensity in watts per square meter, but by default it can be read in decibels because that is how people usually reason about loudness. Most source-side figures are reported in dB SPL and then converted into physical intensity for canonical storage, so the item names emphasize context such as distance from the source. That keeps whispers, appliances, traffic, thunder, jets, and launch pads on one comparable axis while still allowing direct intensity units when needed.
